subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official operator reconcile/reset workflow for model configuration, and which persisted model/auth selections may it change by default?
rationale: Current code intentionally preserves explicit session and legacy model/auth selections, while the proposal would add a command capable of changing persisted state across agents, stores, provider routes, and auth profiles.

options.title: Dry-run reconcile and scoped reset
options.body: Add a report-first command or doctor mode that labels default, agent, session, provider, and generated-registry sources, then clears only selected scopes when the operator passes explicit flags.

options.title: Resolver refactor first
options.body: Keep this proposal behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87957 until selected/runtime/display/auth semantics are centralized, then build operator tooling on that resolver.

options.title: Document current manual recovery
options.body: Keep `/model default`, `/reset`, `sessions.reset`, and doctor route cleanup as the supported path, and narrow or close this proposal after documenting what will not be automated.

recommendation.title: Dry-run reconcile and scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add a report-first command or doctor mode that labels default, agent, session, provider, and generated-registry sources, then clears only selected scopes when the operator passes explicit flags.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest observed owner across the current model CLI, session reset/patch, status, doctor cleanup, and prior shared session-model history.
